name: subagent-models
description: Native Claude Code subagents on non-Claude models (OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs), routed through a gateway with fallback chains: one on this machine (configured in ~/.config/subagent-models/config.yml) or a remote one reached with a gateway key.

gatewayUrl.title: Gateway URL
gatewayUrl.description: A remote gateway's HTTPS URL, such as the hosted one, https://llm-gateway.execution.associates. Leave empty to use the gateway running on this machine. SUBAGENT_MODELS_URL overrides it.

apiKey.title: Gateway key
apiKey.description: The remote gateway's key (the hosted gateway's dashboard issues them), sent as a Bearer token. Not needed for a gateway on this machine. SUBAGENT_MODELS_API_KEY overrides it.
